children.AXLabel: Phone numbers and send channels used by Rapid Send All.
Phone numbers and send channels used by Rapid Send All.
SMS opens Messages with the order pre-typed to the supplier's number. WhatsApp opens a chat with the message pre-filled. Suppliers without a phone number fall back to the share sheet during Send All.
